change_summary: Clarify the user-configured Workspace authority for selected ordinary files without weakening sensitive, local-only, disclosure, routing, or OAuth boundaries.

canonical_skill.note: The internal shared Skill release 1.7.20 presents the connected Workspace as a preconfigured user work surface and keeps task scope bounded to selected ordinary files.

server_contract.note: The 2026-09-09.7 wire contract remains compatible; its shared owner now exposes configured-Workspace authority separately from source, disclosure, routing, and OAuth boundaries.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.20 while retaining the compatible 2026-09-09.7 collaboration contract.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.23 remains compatible with the unchanged 2026-09-09.7 wire contract; this release does not change CLI bytes.

help_center.note: Existing multilingual MCP Help already covers natural delegation and canonical artifact URLs; no Help bytes change in 1.7.20.

package_setup.note: The Claude Plugin hook now presents installed OAuth Workspace authority and the coherent-corpus boundary as compact factual context without a MUST instruction or a second workflow.

harness_and_mainline.note: The host-neutral 30 by 2 denominator remains unchanged; the Harness records configured-surface authority, separately freezes host-owned user guidance, and verifies host-native derived files independently from remote persistence.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; the two-host fresh acceptance matrix remains runtime evidence and WorkBuddy is outside this cycle.

release_evidence.note: Evidence covers Skill/package identity, separate host user-guidance identity, configured-Workspace task scope, ordinary-business transfer, exclusion-first no-call behavior, and the host-neutral portfolio.
